_about: Public-domain Ezra Stiles Gannett (1801-1871), Channing's colleague and successor at the Federal Street (later Arlington Street) Church, Boston, for the Word Hoard: his sermons and discourses 1831-1869: A Sermon for Children, The Religion of Politics (election sermon), The Value of Natural Religion (Dudleian lecture), Peace not War, The Faith of the Unitarian Christian, Thanksgiving for the Union, Relation of the North to Slavery, The State of the Country, Positive Faith, memorial discourses, and others. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 92 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
